backing.note: Packaging default for a new Desktop install, per the composition lock section 3. It is a disclosure, not an action: the backing products install through their own flows and adding or removing the Desktop never reinstalls ground, reconstitutes Agents or renames Projects.

never_owned: Central ground: Control/, Work/ and .central under the personal ground are never created, moved or deleted by the Desktop installer
Agent and Project records: adding or removing the Desktop never reconstitutes Agents or renames Projects
system package-manager databases: deb/rpm installs are separate owner flows and are not installed or removed here
